questions.question: What is the source of truth for Throne git claims?
questions.answer: Local git object verification plus bundle manifest; GitHub URL is optional presentation evidence.

questions.question: Which organ owns language and role output?
questions.answer: Officio Agentis owns Owner-facing Russian runtime language; machine artifacts remain English UTF-8 no BOM.

questions.question: What cap applies if laptop runtime is missing?
questions.answer: CAP_THRONE_LAPTOP_NOT_LIVE_PROVISIONED_IN_THIS_TASK; it blocks runtime provisioning claims, not foundation contracts.

questions.question: What would make the task fake-green?
questions.answer: Claiming Custodes, claiming GitHub URL authority over local git object proof, hiding dirty state, or claiming push sync before post-push verification.
